lines.text: How's work going? Tell me if anything's tough.
Back when I was a new hire, all-nighters were normal.
That report's on the right track, just polish it a bit more.
You heard this quarter's targets, right? Our team needs to step up.
Want to take on next week's presentation?
Young folks these days are so quiet. Speak up in meetings.
What'd you do this weekend? You should try hiking.
So you know what I told the CEO back then…

flushRemark.text: What's with your face? Not feeling well?

closers.satisfied: Alright, keep it up. Looking forward to it.
closers.parried: Yeah, yeah, get back to it.
closers.endured: …Anyway, that's what I mean. Off you go.
